edit.description: ledger-refusal wave that ships nothing and carries a gate-revert cause

summary: Pin the wave no-commit cause on the verdict a ledger-rewrite refusal carries — all three existing refusal tests ship an entry, so the leg never runs

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

pins: a ledger-rewrite refusal over a wave that shipped nothing carries the wave's gate-revert cause on its verdict
acceptance: A fanout wave whose only entry is afterCommit-gate-reverted (footprint recorded, nothing shipped) and whose commitPendingUpdate rewrite read hits a corrupt ledger refuses with a verdict carrying noCommit "gate-revert".
notes: src/Dispatcher.ts:2949 is the refusal-site call. Every existing exercise of it (tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:5906, :5954, tests/cli.test.ts:490) ships an entry, so waveNoCommitCause short-circuits on committedWave and the precedence never evaluates. Reach the leg with shipped=0 plus a non-empty footprint (:2586 pushes afterCommit-reverted). The block comment at tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:7421 still cites Dispatcher.ts:1836-1853 for that precedence; it lives at waveNoCommitCause.
